description: Real GDP per capita (inflation-adjusted GDP divided by population) for all countries, expressed in constant 2015 US dollars per person. Calculated from World Bank API indicators: NY.GDP.MKTP.KD (GDP, constant 2015 US$) divided by SP.POP.TOTL (Population, total). Represents standard of living and economic output per person.

yAxis.label: Real Gdp Per Capita (2015 USD per person)
